test.publication_gate: Do not create the effect path until this PREPARED STATE update succeeds by CAS and exact readback confirms this exact slice_id/effect_key/effect_path.
test.recovery_rule: If resumed from PREPARED, read the deterministic effect path. If absent, create it once. If present with matching effect_key and payload contract, do not recreate; advance STATE to COMMITTED. A mismatch is a conflict and must not publish another effect.

crash_windows.before_prepare_commit: No effect may exist because publication is forbidden before PREPARED readback.
crash_windows.after_prepare_before_publish: Resume from durable PREPARED state and publish once.
crash_windows.after_publish_before_final_state: Deterministic create-if-absent effect path makes the already-visible effect discoverable and prevents duplicate publication on resume.

tested_scope: Repository-visible, immutable, deterministic-path effects whose publication can be expressed as Chat-exposed repository create-if-absent after a role-local CAS checkpoint/readback.

assessment.conflict_check: Only frozen sanitized controls and own reasoning STATE are semantic inputs; no O, downstream, other-worker, legacy, shared-ledger or other-role receipt semantics are used.
assessment.scope_limit: This PREPARED state does not yet prove publication. It covers only repository-visible effects with deterministic create-if-absent/readback semantics; arbitrary external side effects without idempotency/reconciliation remain unresolved.

remaining_frontier: Complete this single crash-window leaf by publishing the deterministic role-local effect only after PREPARED readback, then finalize STATE and receipt.
Later test or classify an external effect class lacking deterministic create-if-absent/readback semantics.
continuation: If this invocation stops after PREPARED, fresh-bootstrap next invocation, exact-read this STATE, then read only the deterministic effect_path. If absent, create it once; if present and matching, do not recreate. Advance STATE to COMMITTED only after exact effect readback. Keep enabled_desired=true, global_completion=false and Phase 1 open.
